lines.text: The LORD tells the priests who despise His name that they present defiled food on His altar.
The LORD says offering blind, lame and sick animals is wrong and challenges the priests to offer them to their king.
The LORD says His name will be great among the nations, from where the sun rises to where it sets.
The LORD curses the deceiver who vows an acceptable male but sacrifices a defective animal, for He is a great Shepherd.
The priests departed from the way and violated the covenant of Levi, so the LORD made them despised before all the people.
